packageRules.description: The hashed certbot lock is regenerated by pip-compile, never edited one package at a time
Headscale and Tailscale are protocol-critical; never automerge, review release notes
Every Headscale pin moves in one pull request
prBodyNotes: Before merging, by hand (docs/implementation-plan.md P0.2 is the worked example): read the release notes for migrations and API changes; set `HEADSCALE_DEB_SHA256` in `deploy/server/bootstrap.sh` from the release checksums; move `PREV_HEADSCALE_VERSION` and its checksum in `deploy/tests/e2e.sh` to the release being replaced; update the vendored `proto/headscale` and `gen/headscale` if the API changed, plus `LICENSING.md` and `cmd/headmesh-cellagent/main_test.go`; run `deploy/tests/e2e.sh` and `go test -tags e2e ./test/e2e/`.

packageRules.description: Every Tailscale pin (apt, sandbox image, e2e image) moves in one pull request
prBodyNotes: Running hosts don't re-bootstrap: after merging, roll tailscaled out with an announced `apt-get install tailscale=<version>` (detached with `systemd-run` where SSH rides the tailnet).

packageRules.description: certbot's bootstrap pin and its hashed lock move together
mise names protoc-gen-connect-go by its package path; the /v2 in the middle defeats the Go proxy and go-get, so look up the module
Code generators: the mise pins and the CI install lines must stay equal, or the generated-code diff fails
golangci-lint: mise and the CI action version move together
gitleaks: the sandbox build, the ASUS prep script and the CI scanner image move together
pnpm: package.json's packageManager (npm manager) and the workflow pins move together
Pins with a SHA256 next to them: Renovate can't recompute it
prBodyNotes: This pin has a `*_SHA256` next to it that Renovate cannot update. Replace it with the checksum from the upstream release before merging; the build or deploy test fails closed until you do.
